source: NASA POWER API response, actual network retrieval; not a farm observation
retrieval_time_note: The initial probe retained original body bytes and status but did not record an exact retrieval timestamp. Date is known; no timestamp invented.
conclusion: API v2.10.3 rounds response coordinates to three decimals for this high-precision query; 1e-6 rejects it. Allow half the three-decimal quantization step plus floating-point epsilon. This validates response association, not true pixel or farm accuracy.
